import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int Maxn = 10;
    static final long mod = 1000000007L;
    static int[][] p = new int[Maxn][Maxn];
    static int n;
    static int[] id = new int[64];
    static int ki = 0;
    static long[] X = new long[1 << 20];
    static long[] Y = new long[1 << 20];
    static int[] a = new int[6], b = new int[6], c = new int[6];
    static int[] A_mask = new int[1 << 6];

    static long qp(long x, long p) {
        long ret = 1;
        while (p > 0) {
            if ((p & 1) == 1) ret = ret * x % mod;
            x = x * x % mod;
            p >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static long inv(long x) {
        return qp(x, mod - 2);
    }

    static void add(LongHolder x, long y) {
        x.value += y;
        if (x.value >= mod) x.value -= mod;
    }

    static void sub(LongHolder x, long y) {
        x.value -= y;
        if (x.value < 0) x.value += mod;
    }

    static class LongHolder {
        long value;

        LongHolder(long v) {
            this.value = v;
        }
    }

    static void FWT(long[] P, int opt) {
        int N = 1 << 20;
        for (int i = 2; i <= N; i <<= 1) {
            for (int p = i >> 1, j = 0; j < N; j += i) {
                for (int k = j; k < j + p; k++) {
                    if (opt == 1) {
                        add(new LongHolder(P[k]), P[k + p]);
                        P[k] = (P[k] + P[k + p]) % mod;
                    } else {
                        sub(new LongHolder(P[k]), P[k + p]);
                        P[k] = (P[k] - P[k + p] + mod) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int temp = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j] = (int) ((long) temp * inv(100) % mod);
            }
        }

        if (n < 6) {
            for (int i = n; i < 6; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                    p[i][j] = 0;
                }
                p[i][i] = 1;
            }
            n = 6;
        }

        int A = (1 << 6) - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(i) == 3) {
                id[i] = ki++;
            }
        }

        // Precompute A_mask for 6 bits
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 6); i++) {
            A_mask[i] = i;
        }

        // Processing X array
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++) {
            int msk1 = i & A;
            int msk2 = (i >> 6) & A;
            int msk3 = (i >> 12) & A;
            long maskVal = 0;
            long pp = 1;

            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk1 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[0][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[0][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk2 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[1][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[1][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk3 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[2][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[2][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            if (pp == 0) continue;

            for (int a_idx = 0; a_idx < 6; a_idx++) {
                if (((msk1 >> a_idx) & 1) == 1) {
                    for (int b_idx = 0; b_idx < 6; b_idx++) {
                        if (a_idx == b_idx) continue;
                        if (((msk2 >> b_idx) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int c_idx = 0; c_idx < 6; c_idx++) {
                                if (a_idx == c_idx || b_idx == c_idx) continue;
                                if (((msk3 >> c_idx) & 1) == 1) {
                                    int nmsk = (1 << a_idx) | (1 << b_idx) | (1 << c_idx);
                                    maskVal |= 1L << id[nmsk];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            add(new LongHolder(X[0]), maskVal);
            X[0] = (X[0] + maskVal) % mod; // for cumulative addition
        }

        // Processing Y array
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++) {
            int msk1 = i & A;
            int msk2 = (i >> 6) & A;
            int msk3 = (i >> 12) & A;
            long maskVal = 0;
            long pp = 1;

            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk1 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[3][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[3][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk2 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[4][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[4][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk3 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[5][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[5][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            if (pp == 0) continue;

            for (int a_idx = 0; a_idx < 6; a_idx++) {
                if (((msk1 >> a_idx) & 1) == 1) {
                    for (int b_idx = 0; b_idx < 6; b_idx++) {
                        if (a_idx == b_idx) continue;
                        if (((msk2 >> b_idx) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int c_idx = 0; c_idx < 6; c_idx++) {
                                if (a_idx == c_idx || b_idx == c_idx) continue;
                                if (((msk3 >> c_idx) & 1) == 1) {
                                    int nmsk = (1 << a_idx) | (1 << b_idx) | (1 << c_idx);
                                    int nmsk2 = nmsk ^ A;
                                    maskVal |= 1L << id[nmsk2];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            add(new LongHolder(Y[0]), maskVal);
            Y[0] = (Y[0] + maskVal) % mod;
        }

        // Forward FWT
        FWT(X, 1);
        FWT(Y, 1);

        // Convolution
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            X[i] = (X[i] * Y[i]) % mod;
        }

        // Inverse FWT
        FWT(X, -1);

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            ans = (ans + X[i]) % mod;
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
